newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Phoneware plans ASX listing, to raise A$5 million.
newsitem.headline: Phoneware plans ASX listing, to raise A$5 million.

text.p: Telecommunications services company Phoneware Communications Systems Ltd said it planned to list on the Australian Stock Exchange based on an issue of 25 million shares at 20 cents each.

The company said the offering of 48.8 percent of its stock, to raise A$5 million, was fully underwritten and it believed the issue would be fully subscribed. It did not name the underwriting broker to the offer.
Phoneware said it had issued a prospectus in anticipation of the float. Funds raised would be used to support domestic growth, to launch new products and for further Asian expansion.
